name: PHYSICS
blurb: MATTER, ENERGY AN' SPACETIME UNDER MEASUREMENT. PRECISION DEPENDS ON DA APPARATUS YOU CAN BUILD!

phys_attosecond.name: ATTOSECOND LIGHT PULSES
phys_attosecond.desc: HIGH HARMONIC GENERATION. A FEMTOSECOND DRIVIN' FIELD IONISES ARGON OR NEON BY TUNNELLIN', ACCELERATES DA FREED ELECTRON THROUGH HALF AN OPTICAL CYCLE AN' RECOLLIDES IT WIT DA PARENT ION; RECOMBINATION EMITS ODD HARMONICS OF DA FUNDAMENTAL OUT TA A CUTOFF FIXED BY DA PONDEROMOTIVE ENERGY. DA HARMONICS IZ MUTUALLY PHASE LOCKED, SO FILTERIN' SOME TWENTY ELECTRONVOLTS OF BANDWIDTH AROUND DA CUTOFF LEAVES A SINGLE BURST OF ABOUT 250 ATTOSECONDS. DA ATOMIC UNIT OF TIME IZ 24 ATTOSECONDS, AN' PUMP-PROBE BELOW DAT FIGURE NO LONGER AVERAGES OVER DA ELECTRONIC MOTION IT IZ MEANT TA RECORD!

phys_slowlight.name: SLOW LIGHT CONDENSATES
phys_slowlight.desc: A COUPLIN' LASER OPENS A TRANSPARENCY WINDOW IN A SODIUM BOSE-EINSTEIN CONDENSATE AT 450 NANOKELVIN, AN' DA STEEP NORMAL DISPERSION ACROSS DAT WINDOW GIVES A GROUP INDEX NEAR TEN MILLION: DA PROBE PULSE CROSSES DA CLOUD AT SOME 17 METRES PER SECOND, COMPRESSED TA A LENGTH WELL UNDER DA CLOUD'S OWN. EXTINGUISHIN' DA COUPLIN' BEAM ADIABATICALLY MAPS DA PULSE ONTO A GROUND-STATE SPIN COHERENCE, WHERE IT IZ HELD FOR UP TA A MILLISECOND; RESTORIN' DA BEAM REGENERATES DA PULSE WIT ITS AMPLITUDE AN' PHASE INTACT!

phys_neutrino.name: NEUTRINO OSCILLATION
phys_neutrino.desc: DA SUDBURY OBSERVATORY HOLDS A KILOTONNE OF HEAVY WATER TWO KILOMETRES UNDERGROUND AN' SEPARATES THREE REACTION CHANNELS: CHARGED CURRENT, SENSITIVE TA ELECTRON NEUTRINOS ALONE, NEUTRAL CURRENT, SENSITIVE TA ALL THREE FLAVOURS EQUALLY, AN' ELASTIC SCATTERIN'. DA NEUTRAL-CURRENT RATE GIVES A TOTAL BORON-8 FLUX OF 5.09 MILLION PER SQUARE CENTIMETRE PER SECOND, IN AGREEMENT WIT DA STANDARD SOLAR MODEL, WHILE DA CHARGED-CURRENT RATE ACCOUNTS FOR A THIRD OF IT. DA BALANCE ARRIVES AS MUON AN' TAU NEUTRINOS, AN' FLAVOUR CHANGE IN FLIGHT REQUIRES A NONZERO MASS SPLITTIN' BETWEEN DA EIGENSTATES!

phys_graphene.name: ISOLATION OF GRAPHENE
phys_graphene.desc: REPEATED CLEAVIN' OF PYROLYTIC GRAPHITE WIT ADHESIVE TAPE LEAVES FLAKES ONE ATOM THICK ON A SILICON WAFER CAPPED WIT 300 NANOMETRES OF OXIDE, WHERE A SINGLE LAYER BECOMES VISIBLE IN AN OPTICAL MICROSCOPE THROUGH A FEW PERCENT OF INTERFERENCE CONTRAST. TRANSPORT ON DA FLAKES GIVES A LINEAR DISPERSION WIT FERMI VELOCITY NEAR A MILLION METRES PER SECOND, ROOM-TEMPERATURE MOBILITY ABOVE 10,000 SQUARE CENTIMETRES PER VOLT SECOND, AN' HALL PLATEAUX AT FILLIN' FACTORS FOUR TIMES N PLUS A HALF, DA SEQUENCE EXPECTED OF MASSLESS DIRAC FERMIONS!

phys_teleport.name: QUANTUM TELEPORTATION OF ATOMS
phys_teleport.desc: THREE BERYLLIUM OR CALCIUM IONS SIT IN A SEGMENTED LINEAR TRAP. DA STATE TA BE TRANSFERRED IZ WRITTEN ON ION ONE, IONS TWO AN' THREE IZ ENTANGLED, AN' A JOINT MEASUREMENT ON IONS ONE AN' TWO PROJECTS DAT PAIR ONTO ONE OF FOUR BELL STATES; DA TWO-BIT OUTCOME SELECTS WHICH OF FOUR ROTATIONS IZ APPLIED TA ION THREE, WHICH DEN CARRIES DA ORIGINAL STATE. FIDELITY IZ 0.75 TA 0.78 AGAINST A CLASSICAL BOUND OF 0.66 AN' DA SEQUENCE RUNS IN ABOUT FOUR MILLISECONDS. DA INPUT STATE IZ DESTROYED BY DA MEASUREMENT DAT READS IT, AN' ONLY DA TWO CLASSICAL BITS CROSS DA TRAP!

phys_metamaterial.name: METAMATERIAL CLOAKIN'
phys_metamaterial.desc: TEN CONCENTRIC CYLINDERS CARRY SPLIT-RING RESONATORS ON A PITCH ONE TENTH OF DA FREE-SPACE WAVELENGTH, SO AT 8.5 GIGAHERTZ DA ARRAY BEHAVES AS A CONTINUOUS MEDIUM WHOSE EFFECTIVE PERMEABILITY IZ GRADED FROM ZERO AT DA INNER FACE TA UNITY AT DA OUTER. DA TRANSFORMATION-OPTICS PRESCRIPTION ROUTES DA WAVE AROUND DA HIDDEN CYLINDER AN' RESTORES ITS PHASE FRONT DOWNSTREAM. FIELD MAPPIN' SHOWS A RESIDUAL SHADOW AN' A FEW PERCENT OF REFLECTION: DA RESONATORS IZ LOSSY, AN' DA DESIGN HOLDS OVER A FRACTIONAL BANDWIDTH OF ABOUT ONE PERCENT!

phys_topological.name: TOPOLOGICAL INSULATORS
phys_topological.desc: IN BISMUTH ANTIMONIDE, AN' MORE CLEANLY IN BISMUTH SELENIDE, SPIN-ORBIT COUPLIN' INVERTS DA ORDERIN' OF DA CONDUCTION AN' VALENCE BANDS, AN' DA CHANGE OF DA Z2 INVARIANT BETWEEN CRYSTAL AN' VACUUM FORCES AN ODD NUMBER OF GAPLESS DIRAC CONES ONTO DA SURFACE. ANGLE-RESOLVED PHOTOEMISSION RESOLVES A SINGLE CONE WIT DA SPIN LOCKED PERPENDICULAR TA DA MOMENTUM. ELASTIC BACKSCATTERIN' INTO DA OPPOSITE MOMENTUM WOULD HAB TA REVERSE DAT SPIN, SO IT IZ FORBIDDEN AT FIRST ORDER: DA BULK STAYS INSULATIN' AN' DA SURFACE CHANNEL SURVIVES NON-MAGNETIC DISORDER DAT WOULD LOCALISE AN ORDINARY TWO-DIMENSIONAL METAL!

phys_spintronics.name: GIANT MAGNETORESISTANCE
phys_spintronics.desc: IN AN IRON-CHROMIUM MULTILAYER DA TWO FERROMAGNETIC FILMS COUPLE ANTIPARALLEL THROUGH A CHROMIUM SPACER ABOUT ONE NANOMETRE THICK, AN' A FIELD OF A FEW TENS OF MILLITESLA ALIGNS DEM. DA MEAN FREE PATH OF A CONDUCTION ELECTRON DEPENDS ON WHETHER ITS SPIN IZ PARALLEL OR ANTIPARALLEL TA DA LOCAL MAGNETISATION, SO DA RESISTANCE OF DA STACK FALLS BY UP TA HALF AT 4.2 KELVIN AN' BY SOME TEN PERCENT AT ROOM TEMPERATURE. READ HEADS BUILT FIRST ON DA MULTILAYER AN' DEN ON MAGNETIC TUNNEL JUNCTIONS CARRY AREAL DENSITY PAST 100 GIGABITS PER SQUARE INCH!

phys_dark_energy.name: ACCELERATIN' UNIVERSE CONFIRMED
phys_dark_energy.desc: TYPE IA SUPERNOVAE IZ STANDARDISED THROUGH DA WIDTH-LUMINOSITY RELATION, WHICH TIES PEAK ABSOLUTE MAGNITUDE TA DA DECLINE RATE OF DA LIGHT CURVE TA WITHIN ABOUT 0.15 MAGNITUDES. OUT TA REDSHIFT ONE DEY COME IN 0.2 TA 0.3 MAGNITUDES FAINTER DEN ANY DECELERATIN' EXPANSION ALLOWS, AN' NEITHER GREY DUST NOR EVOLUTION OF DA PROGENITORS REPRODUCES DA DEFICIT WIT DA REDSHIFT DEPENDENCE REQUIRED. COMBINED WIT DA MICROWAVE BACKGROUND AN' DA BARYON ACOUSTIC SCALE, DA FIT GIVES A FLAT GEOMETRY, A MATTER DENSITY OF 0.27 AN' A COMPONENT OF EQUATION OF STATE MINUS ONE WITHIN A TENTH HOLDIN' DA REMAINDER!

phys_superconductor.name: IRON-BASED SUPERCONDUCTORS
phys_superconductor.desc: FLUORINE-DOPED LANTHANUM IRON ARSENIDE OXIDE SUPERCONDUCTS AT 26 KELVIN, AN' SUBSTITUTIN' DA RARE EARTH RAISES DA CRITICAL TEMPERATURE TA 55 KELVIN IN DA SAMARIUM COMPOUND. PAIRIN' TAKES PLACE IN DA IRON-ARSENIC PLANES, WIT HOLE AN' ELECTRON POCKETS ON SEPARATE SHEETS OF DA FERMI SURFACE AN' A GAP DAT IZ NODELESS ON EACH SHEET BUT CHANGES SIGN BETWEEN DEM. DA PARENT COMPOUNDS IZ ANTIFERROMAGNETIC METALS WHOSE ORDER IZ SUPPRESSED BY DOPIN', AN' DA SUPERCONDUCTIN' DOME OPENS WHERE DAT ORDER CLOSES; UPPER CRITICAL FIELDS EXCEED 50 TESLA WIT LIL' ANISOTROPY!

phys_lhc.name: FIRST BEAM AT DA LHC
phys_lhc.desc: DA MACHINE OCCUPIES DA 26.7 KILOMETRE LEP TUNNEL: 1,232 DIPOLES AT 8.3 TESLA BEND TWO COUNTER-ROTATIN' PROTON BEAMS, 392 QUADRUPOLES FOCUS DEM, AN' SIXTEEN RADIOFREQUENCY CAVITIES AT 400 MEGAHERTZ HOLD DA BUNCH STRUCTURE. EACH BEAM CARRIES 2,808 BUNCHES OF ABOUT 115 BILLION PROTONS ON A 25 NANOSECOND SPACIN', FOR SOME 360 MEGAJOULES OF STORED ENERGY PER BEAM AT DA DESIGN SEVEN TERA-ELECTRONVOLTS. BEAM IZ THREADED AROUND DA RING IN BOTH DIRECTIONS ON DA FIRST ATTEMPT; NINE DAYS LATER A DEFECTIVE MAGNET INTERCONNECT VAPORISES, 53 MAGNETS IZ DAMAGED AN' DA RING IZ DOWN FOR FOURTEEN MONTHS!

phys_quantum_machine.name: DA FIRST QUANTUM MACHINE
phys_quantum_machine.desc: A FILM BULK ACOUSTIC RESONATOR 40 MICROMETRES ACROSS, ITS DILATATIONAL MODE AT 6 GIGAHERTZ, IZ COOLED IN A DILUTION REFRIGERATOR TA 25 MILLIKELVIN, WHERE DA THERMAL OCCUPATION OF DAT MODE FALLS BELOW 0.07 PHONONS. A PHASE QUBIT TUNED INTO RESONANCE EXCHANGES A SINGLE QUANTUM WIT IT IN ABOUT TEN NANOSECONDS AN' SWAPS IT BACK, AN' DA TOMOGRAPHY DAT FOLLOWS SHOWS DA RESONATOR IN A SUPERPOSITION OF ZERO AN' ONE PHONON. DA OSCILLATOR CONTAINS OF ORDER TEN TRILLION ATOMS; DA STATE SURVIVES SOME SIX NANOSECONDS!

phys_ftl_neutrino.name: DA FASTER-DEN-LIGHT ANOMALY
phys_ftl_neutrino.desc: MUON NEUTRINOS IZ TIMED OVER DA 730 KILOMETRES FROM CERN TA GRAN SASSO AGAINST CAESIUM CLOCKS DISCIPLINED BY GPS, AN' DA ARRIVAL MAXIMUM FALLS 60.7 NANOSECONDS EARLY, WIT 6.9 STATISTICAL AN' 7.4 SYSTEMATIC, A RELATIVE EXCESS OF 25 PARTS PER MILLION OVER DA SPEED OF LIGHT. DA SYSTEMATIC BUDGET IZ DOMINATED BY DA FIBRE CHAIN CARRYIN' DA TIMIN' SIGNAL TA DA DETECTOR MASTER CLOCK. METROLOGY AFTERWARDS FINDS ONE CONNECTOR SEATED LOOSE, WORTH 73 NANOSECONDS, AN' AN OSCILLATOR DRIFT OF DA OPPOSITE SIGN; CORRECTED, DA VELOCITY IZ CONSISTENT WIT C. ERIS LATER ADMITS TA DA CONNECTOR!

phys_higgs.name: DISCOVERY OF DA HIGGS BOSON
phys_higgs.desc: ATLAS AN' CMS EACH ANALYSE ABOUT FIVE INVERSE FEMTOBARNS AT SEVEN TERA-ELECTRONVOLTS AN' FIVE MORE AT EIGHT, AN' EACH REPORTS AN EXCESS IN DA TWO-PHOTON AN' FOUR-LEPTON CHANNELS AT 125.3 GIGA-ELECTRONVOLTS, OF LOCAL SIGNIFICANCE 5.0 AN' 4.9 STANDARD DEVIATIONS. DA OBSERVED WIDTH IZ CONSISTENT WIT DETECTOR RESOLUTION, SPIN-PARITY FITS FAVOUR ZERO-PLUS, AN' DA SIGNAL STRENGTHS ACROSS DA TWO-PHOTON, ZZ, WW AN' TAU-TAU CHANNELS AGREE WIT A SCALAR WHOSE COUPLIN' TA EACH PARTICLE SCALES WIT DAT PARTICLE'S MASS. DA TWO COLLABORATIONS KEEP DEY ANALYSES BLINDED FROM EACH OTHER UNTIL DA JOINT SEMINAR!

phys_emdrive.name: DA EMDRIVE
phys_emdrive.desc: A SEALED COPPER FRUSTUM IZ DRIVEN ON A TRANSVERSE ELECTRIC MODE NEAR 2.45 GIGAHERTZ AN' REPORTED TA YIELD A FEW TENS OF MICRONEWTONS PER KILOWATT, ATTRIBUTED TA UNEQUAL RADIATION PRESSURE ON DA WIDE AN' NARROW END PLATES. MOMENTUM CONSERVATION FORBIDS NET THRUST FROM A CLOSED CAVITY, AN' DA QUOTED FIGURE SITS THREE ORDERS OF MAGNITUDE BELOW DA RESOLUTION OF DA PENDULUMS USED TA OBTAIN IT. TORSION BALANCE RETESTS AT TEN MICROPASCAL REPRODUCE DA SIGNAL, DEN REPRODUCE IT WIT DA MAGNETRON DETUNED: IT TRACKS THERMAL EXPANSION OF DA MOUNT AN' DA LORENTZ FORCE ON DA UNSHIELDED FEED CABLE IN DA EARTH'S FIELD!

phys_coldfusion.name: DA ENERGY CATALYZER
phys_coldfusion.desc: NICKEL POWDER LOADED WIT HYDROGEN AN' HEATED BY A RESISTIVE ELEMENT IZ PRESENTED AS A NICKEL-TA-COPPER FUSION REACTOR OF GAIN SIX OR BETTER. OUTPUT IZ INFERRED FROM DA ENTHALPY OF A STEAM LOOP WHOSE DRYNESS FRACTION IZ NEVER MEASURED, SO ENTRAINED WATER CAN INFLATE DA FIGURE SEVERAL-FOLD, AN' LATER RUNS IZ READ OFF A THERMAL CAMERA SET TA AN ASSUMED EMISSIVITY. INPUT POWER IZ METERED UPSTREAM OF A CONTROL BOX DA INVENTOR KEEPS SEALED. NO NEUTRON FLUX ABOVE BACKGROUND, NO ANNIHILATION LINE AT 511 KILO-ELECTRONVOLTS AN' NO ISOTOPIC SHIFT IN DA SPENT CHARGE IZ EVER PRODUCED, AN' DA CHARGE IZ NEVER ASSAYED BY AN INDEPENDENT LABORATORY!

phys_electric_universe.name: ELECTRIC UNIVERSE THEORY
phys_electric_universe.desc: A COSMOLOGY IN WHICH STARS IZ ANODES IN A GALACTIC GLOW DISCHARGE, GRAVITY IZ A WEAK RESIDUE OF ELECTROSTATICS, AN' CRATERS, CANYONS AN' COMET JETS IZ ELECTRICAL MACHININ' SCARS. SUSTAININ' DA SOLAR LUMINOSITY FROM AN EXTERNAL CURRENT CALLS FOR SOMETHIN' NEAR A QUINTILLION AMPERES; A CURRENT DAT SIZE WOULD RADIATE A SYNCHROTRON SIGNATURE NO ALL-SKY SURVEY RECORDS AT ANY FREQUENCY, AN' WOULD DEFLECT SPACECRAFT MAGNETOMETERS BY ORDERS OF MAGNITUDE MORE DEN DEY READ. DA MODEL DERIVES NO MAIN SEQUENCE, NO STELLAR LIFETIME AN' NO ABUNDANCE PATTERN, AN' STATES NO NUMBER A MEASUREMENT COULD FALSIFY!

phys_sc_magnets.name: SUPERCONDUCTIN' DIPOLE MAGNETS
phys_sc_magnets.desc: EACH DIPOLE IZ A COLD MASS FIFTEEN METRES LONG HOLDIN' BOTH BEAM APERTURES INSIDE A SINGLE IRON YOKE, WOUND IN TWO LAYERS OF RUTHERFORD CABLE MADE OF NIOBIUM-TITANIUM FILAMENTS SIX MICROMETRES ACROSS IN A COPPER MATRIX. AT 8.3 TESLA AN' 11,850 AMPERES DA LORENTZ FORCE ON DA COIL REACHES SOME 340 TONNES PER METRE, SO DA WINDIN' IZ PRESTRESSED IN AUSTENITIC STEEL COLLARS AT ASSEMBLY AN' MUST NO GO SLACK AS IT CONTRACTS ON COOLDOWN. INTEGRATED FIELD HARMONICS IZ SPECIFIED TA A FEW UNITS IN TEN THOUSAND; EVERY MAGNET IZ MEASURED WARM AN' COLD ON ITS OWN BENCH, SHIMMED, AN' ONLY DEN ASSIGNED A POSITION IN DA RING!

phys_cryogenics.name: CRYOGENICS NEAR ABSOLUTE ZERO
phys_cryogenics.desc: NIOBIUM-TITANIUM CARRIES DA DESIGN CURRENT DENSITY ONLY BELOW ABOUT NINE KELVIN AT 8.3 TESLA, AN' DA MARGIN AGAINST A RESISTIVE TRANSITION IZ A FRACTION OF A KELVIN. DA RING IZ THEREFORE BATHED IN SUPERFLUID HELIUM AT 1.9 KELVIN, WHOSE EFFECTIVE THERMAL CONDUCTIVITY IZ SOME THOUSAND TIMES COPPER'S AN' WHICH SPREADS A LOCAL DEPOSIT BEFORE IT CAN DRIVE A MAGNET NORMAL. DA LOOT SACK IZ 96 TONNES OF HELIUM ACROSS EIGHT INDEPENDENT SECTORS, SERVED BY REFRIGERATION UNITS OF 2.4 KILOWATTS AT 1.8 KELVIN. QUENCH PROTECTION HAB TA REMOVE ABOUT A GIGAJOULE PER SECTOR, DIVERTIN' DA CURRENT INTO DUMP RESISTORS AN' FIRIN' HEATERS DAT SPREAD DA TRANSITION OVER DA WHOLE COIL!

phys_detectors.name: DA ATLAS AN' CMS DETECTORS
phys_detectors.desc: BOTH EXPERIMENTS IZ BUILT AS CONCENTRIC SHELLS AROUND A CROSSIN' POINT: SILICON PIXELS AN' STRIPS FOR TRACKIN', DEN ELECTROMAGNETIC AN' HADRONIC CALORIMETRY, DEN MUON CHAMBERS OUTSIDE DA RETURN YOKE. ATLAS IZ 46 METRES LONG AN' 25 ACROSS, WIT A THIN TWO TESLA SOLENOID AN' AN AIR-CORE TOROID FOR DA MUON SYSTEM; CMS IZ SMALLER, HEAVIER AT 14,000 TONNES, AN' PUTS EVERY LAYER INSIDE A 3.8 TESLA SOLENOID. BETWEEN DEM DEY READ SOME HUNDRED MILLION CHANNELS. BUNCHES CROSS EVERY 25 NANOSECONDS AN' EACH CROSSIN' LEAVES TWENTY OR MORE OVERLAPPIN' INTERACTIONS, SO EVERY CHANNEL IZ TIMED AS WELL AS MEASURED AN' EACH HIT IZ ASSIGNED TA A VERTEX RECONSTRUCTED TA TENS OF MICROMETRES!

phys_grid.name: DA TRIGGER AN' DA GRID
phys_grid.desc: FORTY MEGAHERTZ OF BUNCH CROSSINGS HAB TA BE REDUCED TA A FEW HUNDRED EVENTS WRITTEN PER SECOND. A FIRST LEVEL BUILT FROM CUSTOM ELECTRONICS HOLDS EVERY CHANNEL IN A PIPELINE FOR 2.5 MICROSECONDS WHILE COARSE CALORIMETER AN' MUON DATA PRODUCE A FIXED-LATENCY ACCEPT AT ABOUT 100 KILOHERTZ; A FARM OF COMMODITY PROCESSORS DEN RUNS PARTIAL RECONSTRUCTION ON DA ACCEPTED EVENTS AN' CUTS DEM BY A FURTHER FACTOR OF SEVERAL HUNDRED. WHAT SURVIVES, SOME 300 MEGABYTES PER SECOND, IZ WRITTEN TA TAPE AT CERN AN' REPLICATED ACROSS A TIERED GRID OF ABOUT 170 COMPUTIN' CENTRES IN 42 COUNTRIES, WHERE FULL RECONSTRUCTION AN' DA SIMULATED SAMPLES IZ PRODUCED!
